summary.zh: 在提示词上线前做用例对比测试并留存版本差异
summary.en: Test prompts against cases and keep diffed versions before launch

description.zh: 在提示词正式上线前，用一组典型用例做对比测试，记录每轮改动并保留可回溯的版本差异。适合营销团队评审、复用或交接提示词时使用。运行附带的示例脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Runs comparison tests of prompts against representative cases and keeps a diffed history of every revision, so teams can review and reuse prompts with confidence. The included sample scripts need a local Python setup.
